chunks: ʿAlī, from his father, from Khālid ibn Saʿīd, from Yūnus, from Ibn Muskān, from Abī Baṣīr, who said:

I asked him about a man who arrives to the Imam when he is saying the salām. He said: “He is not required to repeat the adhan, so let him enter with them in their adhan; but if he finds that they have dispersed, he should repeat the adhan.”

key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the prayer leader of the congregation
key_terms.تَفَرَّقُوا: they dispersed and left the gathering
key_terms.فَلْيَدْخُلْ: so let him join or enter
key_terms.يُسَلِّمُ: is concluding the prayer with salām

ai.seo_question: Does someone who arrives at the Imam’s salām need to repeat the adhan?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who reaches the congregational prayer at its conclusion. If he arrives while the congregation is still present, he does not need to repeat the adhan; but if they have already dispersed, he should give the adhan again.
